label: Interface materials
subgoals: Divide bond-line thickness by conductivity times area
Multiply by power for the drop

label: Required heat-sink resistance
subgoals: Divide the junction-to-ambient budget by power
Subtract the junction-to-case and interface resistances
Pick a sink at or below the remainder

label: Convection and fin area
subgoals: Write the convective resistance as one over h times area
Solve for the area at the target resistance
Convert square metres to square centimetres
